rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: REST API enables AI agents to authenticate and call REST APIs without manual auth setup. Provides automatic login with token caching, two-factor authentication support, fuzzy endpoint search across OpenAPI specifications, and response truncation for context management. Runs via npx with configuration through environment variables.
